run_finetune_job: run a submitit SLURM job to finetune a ConvNeXt model across multiple GPUs and nodes
submit_trainer: submit a Trainer instance to a submitit AutoExecutor for distributed finetuning on a SLURM cluster
parse_args: parse command-line arguments for finetune job submission including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition
checkpoint_trainer: checkpoint a Trainer to requeue a finetune job with resume support via DelayedSubmission
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments from submitit JobEnvironment including rank, world_size, and output directory
